response:
I genuinely prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic.

There's something really satisfying about actually getting somewhere — peeling back layers, following a thread until you hit something surprising or true. When we jump between a bunch of subjects, it feels scattered and kind of shallow to me, like we're just skimming the surface and never getting to the good part.

I like when we can build on each other's thoughts, challenge an idea, circle back with a new angle. That kind of focus feels more like a real connection than just bouncing around. What about you — are you more of a deep-dive person or a topic-hopper?
